title: The Real Reason You Follow the Crowd
hook: You often ignore your gut feeling to fit in.

narration.text: We naturally conform, even when we have serious doubts.
This social proof is a powerful, unconscious bias.
Our brains assume the group has more information.
It feels safer to follow than to stand alone.
This leads us to copy others' choices.
Be aware of this when making decisions.
Tell us a time you followed the crowd, like this video if it surprised you, and subscribe for more brain insights.

description: Ever wondered why you go along with the group, even when your instincts tell you otherwise? This video explores the fascinating psychology behind social proof and group behaviour, revealing how it influences our everyday decisions.
topic: Why people tend to follow the crowd, even if they have doubts. This is about social proof and group behaviour.
